# Sankey

Show flows between nodes, with widths proportional to quantity.

=== "Diagram"

    ```mermaid
    ---
    config:
      sankey:
        showValues: false
        nodeWidth: 15
        nodePadding: 20
    ---
    sankey

    Electricity grid,Heating and cooling - homes,113.726
    Electricity grid,Industry,342.165
    Electricity grid,Losses,56.691
    ```
